artworks.title: Head of Mary Magdalen and Two Saints (?)
artworks.description: The image features three partial portraits, each focusing on the upper portions of the figures from the shoulders up. The first figure on the left is in a three-quarter view, slightly tilted to the right with the head turned upwards. This figure has soft facial features and curly hair. The middle figure is a guideline sketch for a profile portrait, showing the basic structure of the head with lightly outlined facial planes and wavy, long hair. The third figure is also a profile view, turned to the left, with defined facial features and curly hair extending back. All sketches are on a plain background.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies [recto and verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures and architectural structures. The drawing consists of multiple sketches scattered around the page. In the upper left, there is an indistinct figure on a platform, framed by an arch or halo, flanked by two seated shapes suggesting more figures. The lower part of the page is filled with small groups of forms indicating crowd-like gatherings. Some figures are standing, while others appear to cluster together, seemingly in conversation or observation of something unseen. In the upper right corner, a towering structure with figures is present, their contours suggesting they may be interacting. The use of light sketching lines gives the drawing an ethereal, unfinished quality, as if capturing a study or preliminary observations.

artworks.title: Striding Female with Palm
artworks.description: The drawing shows a lightly sketched figure in a sideways view. The person is depicted with a raised left arm holding a round object, and a right arm clutching elongated objects. The facial features are not detailed, and the hair is styled in a loose bun. The clothing is suggested by flowing lines around the lower body, implying drapery or a robe. The background is a plain sheet of paper with visible texture and some minor spots or stains.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies [recto and verso]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract forms and figures. The drawing consists of several loosely rendered clusters and shapes that seem to imply a variety of forms. The pencil or graphite sketches are light and tentative, with a few areas of slightly darker, more concentrated lines. The composition is dominated by round and organic shapes, creating an impression of fluidity and dynamism. Spaces are created between these figures, allowing the eye to wander around the page and contemplate the relationships between these abstract forms.

artworks.title: Design for a Monument
artworks.description: The drawing is a preliminary sketch of a sculpture depicting a seated figure, possibly embracing another smaller figure. The figures are enclosed within a framework resembling an architectural niche, with two columns on each side and a semicircular arch at the top. The base is a rectangular pedestal with simple, block-like feet. The sketch is rendered in fine lines on beige, slightly textured paper, lacking detail. The design emphasizes the figures, incorporating classical architectural elements for framing and context.

artworks.title: Bishop Wulstan, in Worcester Cathedral
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a bishop in religious attire, featuring a mitre on his head and robes with intricate draping. The figure raises one hand in a gesture of blessing, while the other holds a staff. Detailed patterns surround the upper part of the sculpture, carved from stone. The depiction is in black and white, resembling pencil sketching. The bishop stands on an ornate base.

artworks.title: Creation of Eve, from Wells Cathedral
artworks.description: The image displays two human figures, with a third figure partially shown. The central figure is reclining with one arm outstretched, rising from the second figure's side. This figure has a short hairstyle and softly rendered features, unclothed with textured shading emphasizing form. The third figure on the left stands upright, dressed in long, flowing garments with pleats or folds. This figure has longer hair and faces the reclining figure with an outstretched hand. The background features a shaded circular form contrasting with the lighter foreground. Text in the lower portion identifies the scene as "Creation of Eve — Wells Cathedral," with signatures by M. Derman and C. Hullmandel.

artworks.title: Death of Isaac, from Wells Cathedral
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, with only their upper bodies visible. One person is lying down, while the other is bending over them. The figure on the ground has their head resting on their hand. Both figures have indistinct facial features, and are dressed in flowing robes. The background is shaded with a cloud-like pattern and a light, textured surface surrounds the figures.

artworks.title: An Angel, from Wells Cathedral
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated angel. The angel is positioned with one knee raised and the other leg bent beneath them, and the upper body slightly turned to the side. The face of the angel, seen in profile, shows delicate features with a prominent nose, closed lips, and short hair. The angel is wearing a flowing robe and a large circular halo is behind the head. The angel is holding a scroll in their right hand and the left hand rests on the knee. The background is plain with a simple outline enclosing the angel in a clover or quatrefoil shape.

artworks.title: Queen Eleanor, from Waltham Cross
artworks.description: The drawing shows a full-length figure of a person standing upright within a narrow, arched frame. The person is positioned frontally, facing forward with a serene expression. The facial features are delicately sketched, with defined eyes, a subtle nose, and slightly parted lips. The hair is long, flowing down to the shoulders with waves, and the person wears a crown. They are dressed in a long gown, holding a scepter. The background is minimal with shading around the figure within the arch. The image is bordered by a square and includes handwritten text below.

artworks.title: Virgin and Angels, a Key Stone in York
artworks.description: The image depicts a central figure standing with arms crossed over the chest, surrounded by a radiant, oval frame. The figure has long, flowing hair and wears a crown on its head. The facial expression is serene and composed. The clothing is long and flowing, giving the appearance of a robe, and is detailed with draped fabric. Flanking the central figure are four angels, two above and two below, each with intricate wings. These angels have gentle expressions and hairstyles similar to the main figure, wearing simple robes. The background features radiating lines, creating a halo effect around the scene.

artworks.title: Saint John, from Henry the Seventh's Chapel  Westminster Abbey
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a pitcher. The sculpture is rendered in graphite, displaying shading and line work to create depth and texture. The figure is draped in robes, standing with one foot forward, head tilted to one side, and a serene expression. The ornate pitcher adds elegance. The background is shaded, highlighting the figure as the central focus.

artworks.title: Statues in the Architecture of Henry the Seventh's Chapel, Westminster Abbey
artworks.description: The sculpture features religious figures within ornate Gothic canopies. The figures, possibly saints or clergymen, wear robes and some have halos or head coverings. They are posed differently, with some holding objects like books or staffs. Below them are sculptures of angels on a ledge, with one holding a fleur-de-lis symbol. The angels have wings and robes. The sculpture appears to be made of stone or a similar material, showing gray shading. The figures in the sculpture are elevated, giving the impression of looking up at a religious structure, typical in cathedral settings.

artworks.title: Plan of the Palace of Carnac
artworks.description: This is a floor plan of a historical structure. The architectural plan includes several defined areas with rectangular and square shapes connected by pathways or dotted lines. The lower part of the plan depicts multiple smaller structures or rooms branching from a larger central layout. Bold black lines outline the structures and small dotted patterns are used for details, giving a clear, organized impression typical of architectural drafts.

artworks.title: Figure of Bubaste or Isis
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a human figure. The figure appears to be female and is standing upright with one arm bent across the torso while the other arm rests by the side. The sculpture is monochromatic in shades of grey. The figure's head is embellished with a detailed, ornate headdress with patterned details. The legs are shown in a naturalistic stance with subtle shading.

artworks.title: Sculpture at Persepolis, from Le Bruyn's Travels
artworks.description: Two male figures are walking side by side in the image. The man on the left is slightly ahead and has long, curled hair, a beard, and is wearing a cylindrical hat and a draped robe. The man on the right is shorter with curly hair, a short beard, and is holding a large umbrella above them. They are both shown in profile with a plain, light-colored background.

artworks.title: Vishnu, Creating Agent of Brahma, Attitude, the Emblem of Eternity
artworks.description: The image displays curvilinear lines forming the shape of a large shell with a human figure nested inside. The figure is positioned in a curled-up position with limbs drawn towards the mouth. The figure is adorned with beads and bands on its arms and ankles.

artworks.title: Bronze Figure of Minerva, Found in the Barrowof Achilles
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a figure standing upright, clad in draped clothing. Above the figure's head, there are decorative elements that include leaves and possibly faces or masks. The sculpture is flanked by two stylized horse figures, each with a smaller accompanying figure or shadowy silhouette. The overall color of the sculpture is a pale shade, suggesting it might be made of a light-colored stone or material. The sculpture is drawn in a manner that emphasizes its sculptural details, with shadows and outlines giving a sense of depth and dimension.

artworks.title: Daedalian Figures from Bronzes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three small bronze sculptures from the Dædaleon School. The drawing features three distinct figures set against a neutral background, rendered in monochrome. The first figure on the left stands in a frontal pose, its arms by its sides with a simple, archaic smile. The central figure holds what appears to be an axe or hammer in one hand. The figure on the right is depicted with a full lion-skin draped over its shoulders and across its body, positioned in an assertive stance with an arm raised. The attention to detail in the figures' anatomy reflects the archaic style often associated with early Greek art.

artworks.title: Minerva, From a Bronze by Daedalus
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure with one arm raised holding a writing instrument or small staff, and the other arm holding a shield. The figure has an expressionless face with carved features and serene demeanor. The figure is wearing classical robes with armor-like embellishments, bare feet, and no jewelry. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Tydaeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical male statue in a dynamic pose. The drawing depicts a muscular male figure with a detailed focus on the form and contours of the body, highlighting the muscular tension and movement in the pose. The figure is bent forward, with one arm extended downward, grasping an object. The other arm is raised behind. The head is tilted downwards, showcasing defined facial features with curled hair styled in a classical manner. The shading technique emphasizes the anatomical structure and adds depth to the figure. On the left side, there are some letters.

artworks.title: Minerva, by Phidas
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in classical armor holding a large round shield adorned with intricate designs. The person's facial features are defined and they are holding a small winged statuette. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Venus Aphrodite, by Alcamanes
artworks.artist: Richard James Lane after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a nude female figure standing upright in a slightly contrapposto position. She has long hair that she is holding with both hands. Her facial features are softly rendered with a serene expression and a slight smile. The background is plain and lightly shaded.

artworks.title: Venus Aphrodite, by Alcamanes
artworks.artist: Richard James Lane after John Flaxman
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright while combing her long hair with her fingers. The woman has delicate facial features and long, flowing hair. The sketch does not depict any clothing, objects, or jewelry. The background is simple with subtle shading to emphasize the figure.
